payload.title: FVG_CONT recipe vs regime-matched random (BUY-heavy habitat test)

parent_decision.diagnostic_summary: n=82, mean_R≈0.298, win_rate≈0.28, BUY≈78% (64/82), recon OK

payload.question: Phase 7.32 isolation showed FVG_CONT n=82 mean recipe R≈0.30 with ~78% BUY on GOLD H4. The MQL5 entry already requires aligned g_structH1.trend. Does the FVG gap trigger add expectancy beyond regime-matched random entries in the same (trend_bucket × ATR tercile) cells after costs, or is the apparent edge pure habitat / side-mix?

A_BASELINE_BIDIRECTIONAL.definition: All FVG_CONT closed trades from Phase 7.32 isolation diagnostic (BUY+SELL, recipe R).

B_BUY_ONLY.definition: Subset of A with side=BUY (reason contains bull / FVG_cont bull).

C_REGIME_MATCHED_RANDOM_LONG.definition: For each retained B event, one random entry timestamp in the same causal regime cell (D1 trend bucket vs SMA200 × ATR14 tercile) that is not the event bar; exploratory outcome = 10d forward return / ATR14 proxy unless recipe path sim available. Labeled OUTCOME_PROXY when not recipe R.

payload.primary_comparison: B_mean_R_net - C_mean_outcome (paired where possible); exploratory may use proxy for C
payload.primary_outcome: mean net R per closed trade for B (recipe); C may be proxy until confirmatory path sim

decision_rule_frozen.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: n_B < 30 OR power gate not POWER_READY for 0.3R target
decision_rule_frozen.HABITAT_ONLY: n_B>=30 AND (mean_B - mean_C) CI95 includes <=0 after costs/proxy rules
decision_rule_frozen.SIGNAL_SUPPORTED_AS_HYPOTHESIS: n_B>=30 AND (mean_B - mean_C) CI95 lower bound > 0 after base costs (or declared proxy with explicit NON_RECIPE label for exploratory only); still NOT live-ready
decision_rule_frozen.MIXED: any other non-insufficient pattern; no promotion
